title: Why your phone is secretly an AI supercomputer

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if your phone is already more powerful than the supercomputers of just a few years ago?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Modern phones use AI chips like Apple’s Neural Engine and Qualcomm’s Snapdragon, running complex models locally.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But this power raises questions about surveillance, data control, and the erosion of digital privacy.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are embedding on-device AI, encrypting data, and using federated learning to minimize data exposure.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: In the future, phones could be ethical AI hubs, empowering users while protecting their autonomy.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future isn’t just about power—it’s about who controls it and how it’s used.

video_cue: A sleek smartphone interface displaying real-time AI-driven personal assistant, privacy settings, and ethical AI usage metrics.
